AUTOMATON-ENCODE.title: Encode
AUTOMATON-ENCODE.description: Place this card into your [gold]Encode Orb[/gold]. At [blue]3[/blue] cards, merge their effects above this keyword into a [blue]1[/blue]-cost Function card.
AUTOMATON-STASH.title: Stash
AUTOMATON-STASH.description: Place a card into your [gold]Stash Orb[/gold]. Holds up to [blue]5[/blue] cards.
AUTOMATON-COMPILE.title: Compile
AUTOMATON-COMPILE.description: Triggers when this card merges into a Function.
AUTOMATON-ENCODE_PILE.title: Encode Orb
AUTOMATON-ENCODE_PILE.description: An Orb holding up to [blue]3[/blue] cards. When full, compiles effects above [gold]Encode[/gold] into a [blue]1[/blue]-cost Function card.
AUTOMATON-STASH_PILE.title: Stash Orb
AUTOMATON-STASH_PILE.description: An Orb holding up to [blue]5[/blue] cards. At turn start, draw the oldest card.
